name: Anas

review:

name: Imtinan Ahmed
review: I started learning German with this service and honestly, it was so easy to pick up! The lessons were clear, well-structured, and fun, making learning feel less like a chore. Although my plans changed and I ended up not continuing, I still highly recommend this platform to anyone looking to learn a new language. It’s definitely worth trying!

name: S Mehdi
review: I highly recommend learning German with Fluent in German! Before enrolling, I tried watching YouTube videos, but they didn’t help me much. After just two months in this course, my pronunciation improved significantly, and I now feel much more confident in reading and writing. Madam was always available when I needed her guidance. I would 100% recommend Fluent in German.

name: Irfan Shah Bukhari
review: I was enrolled in the weekend classes and my journey with them was amazing. Madam prepared me for A1 exam in less than a month and I passed my exam. I strongly endorse fluent in German !

name: Anum
review:
I want to sincerely thank you for being such a dedicated and inspiring German teacher. Over the course of your lessons, I’ve learned so much not just about the language itself, but also about German culture, communication, and expression.

Your teaching style was clear, organized, and engaging. You always made difficult topics easier to understand, whether it was grammar, vocabulary, or pronunciation. I really appreciated how patient you were, and how you encouraged us to participate and improve without fear of making mistakes.

One of the things I enjoyed most was the way you made learning fun. You used examples from everyday life, interactive activities, and sometimes even humor to keep us motivated. Because of your efforts, I feel much more confident in my ability to speak and understand German.

Thank you again for your hard work and support. You’ve had a big impact on my learning journey, and I’m truly grateful for everything you’ve taught me.

Vielen Dank für alles!
Anum
